metadata.scenario: A patient calls to complain that the physical therapist rushed through yesterday's session in 25 minutes instead of the full 45 minutes. She says she's paying for a full session and expects the full time. She wants a credit or a makeup session.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I'm calling because I'm really frustrated with my last physical therapy session. I'm sorry to hear that, Mary. Can you tell me what happened? Yes, the therapist rushed through the session yesterday. It was only 25 minutes instead of the full 45. I understand how that could be frustrating. You’re right; you deserve the full session. Did the therapist provide any explanation? No, there was no explanation. I feel like I'm paying for a complete session, and I didn't get it. I completely understand your concern. Our physical therapy sessions are designed to meet your needs. Would you like me to look into this? Yes, I would like to see if I can get a credit for the missed time or at least schedule a makeup session. Let me note that down. I want to ensure you’re satisfied with our services. Thank you, I appreciate that. I’ve been really anxious about my treatments, and I need to feel supported. Absolutely, and it’s important to us that you feel reassured. I can follow up with the physical therapist regarding yesterday’s session. That would be great, thank you. Would you like me to have the physical therapist call you directly, or would you prefer I handle it? I think I’d prefer if you could handle it for now. Got it. I’ll reach out and get back to you once I have more information. Thank you, Margaret. I just want to ensure I’m getting all my therapy time. Of course, Mary. And just to confirm, would you be interested in additional support, like a caregiver for companion care during your therapy sessions? Actually, that sounds like it could help. What do you have available? We offer companion care for $25 to $30 an hour, which can include assistance with emotional support during your sessions. That might be really comforting. I’ll think about it. Great! If you decide to go ahead, just let me know, and I can arrange it for you. I will, thank you. You’re welcome, Mary. I’ll get started on your concerns right away. I appreciate it. Have a good day! You too, Mary. Take care!
